lead: BRS holds NY State MWBE, NYC MBE and NMSDC MBE certifications and is listed in the NYC Online Directory of Certified Businesses.
meta_title: MWBE and MBE Certified Movers | BRS
meta_description: Business Relocation Services is a certified MWBE, with NY State, NYC and NMSDC certifications, listed in the NYC Online Directory of Certified Businesses.

paras: Business Relocation Services (BRS) is a certified minority and women-owned business enterprise. We hold NY State MWBE, NYC MBE and NMSDC MBE certifications.
We are proud of these certifications. They promote fairness and equity by helping businesses grow in capacity, connect with opportunities and contribute to the local economy.
Diversity is key to business success in New York State. Working with certified businesses supports that goal.

sections.h2: NYC Online Directory of Certified Businesses
paras: BRS is listed in the New York City Online Directory of Certified Businesses, a public website that promotes certified businesses. Procurement teams can use it to confirm our listing.

sections.h2: Talk to us about your move
paras: We have served New York, New Jersey and Pennsylvania since 1987, and we manage relocation projects for clients anywhere in the US. Whether you are moving an office, a warehouse or another commercial space, request a quote and we will go over the details with you.
